title: Supplier blame versus port congestion
prompt: Inbound lead time rose 42%. Procurement blames Supplier C. Determine the strongest explanation.
facts: Supplier C lead time rose 41%, but Suppliers A and B using the same port rose 38% and 44%.
Suppliers using a different port remained within 5% of baseline.
Factory-ready dates from Supplier C were unchanged.
Port dwell time rose from 2.1 to 6.8 days.
The affected port experienced labor action during the same period.
